signs.Aries: Use your innate charm, and your most ingratiating behavior to twist your partner (current or prospective) around your little finger. This is one time when the right smile could get you anything you want, and the right words could get you even more. It is certainly worth turning on the charm today, as you will be successful in ways you could not have foreseen!
signs.Taurus: The energy of today is very much associated with the needs of both you and your partner (current or prospective). You will feel like talking about what you want on all levels, from the physical through to the metaphysical. If you already have a good relationship, then you will have fun; if not, then you may have a few things to discuss, and the sooner the better!
signs.Gemini: A little tension is set to come between you and your sugar honey, but quite honestly, this is nothing that you can't easily handle. All you have to do is ask yourself whether you are getting enough satisfaction out of the relationship, then be completely honest with yourself and also with your partner (current or prospective). You may feel like getting a lot closer to each other later on!
signs.Cancer: While you can never talk too much, you and your sugar honey may be tired of discussing the ins and out of your love life. It might just encourage you to re-ignite the flame instead, and attempt to rekindle the love that you both felt for each other in the beginning. You have the technology and equipment - all you need do is enjoy yourselves and be happy!
signs.Leo: You will open up to the person to whom you have been wildly attracted but have been too scared to approach until today. While your heart may beat a little faster than normal, you may also find that this time you are not too shy to say what you need to say or do what you need to do. Go for it!
signs.Virgo: You may find that you have more success in the dating stakes if you don't wear clothes that are too flashy or wear too much gold at this evening's gathering. Be more demure in both your image and your mode of expression. You will impress all of the right people far more if you know what you are talking about.
signs.Libra: Be more tender and loving toward your love interest. If your relationship is currently thriving, then expect to feel like getting even closer to one another once again. If you have just met that special someone, then you may find the force of attraction greater than you imagined. Be prepared for more than you originally bargained for.
signs.Scorpio: Those special qualities that you just love to explore and tease out within the arena of your close personal relationships are especially apparent right now. You are extremely attractive to others and may find yourself the center of attention on more than one occasion. If you have a person you are eager to impress, then turn on your best smile and watch them melt.
signs.Sagittarius: You will have the urge to express how you genuinely feel about the latest person in your life. You do have a tendency to hide your real emotions, but today you feel like saying it like it is, and this may do more to cement and strengthen the current bond than any of the more outrageous tokens of your affection you may have demonstrated lately.
signs.Capricorn: Although you may not feel quite so physically attracted to your love interest as usual, you are likely to somehow strengthen the bond between you and urge you to renew your sense of commitment. You will feel extremely close on an emotional level, and because of this will find that you become naturally closer on other levels; so, don't let this temporary phase worry you.
signs.Aquarius: Take a long hard look at your most personal relationships and own up to your motives for setting each of them in motion. If, in your heart of hearts you know that you have not been true to your deeper self, then it is time for some real thought. You either redress the balance or decide to end the partnership.
signs.Pisces: Take time to get in touch with your deeper feelings concerning your most personal relationship. If you have certain issues that need discussing, then do so while you are able to offset any difficulties with a degree of charm. Above all be honest and consider whether you are both attending to each other's needs or solely to your own. By being truthful, your relationship will greatly improve!
